title: Mother's gallbladder surgery
diagnosis: Gallbladder stones – keyhole surgery to remove the gallbladder

checklist.name: Claim form, part A (you sign it)
checklist.source: Insurer's website or the hospital's insurance desk
checklist.why: Needed for every claim where you paid first

checklist.name: Claim form, part B (the hospital fills it)
checklist.why: The hospital confirms what treatment was given

checklist.name: Discharge summary
checklist.source: Ward or billing desk when you leave
checklist.why: Shows the illness and the treatment given

checklist.name: Final hospital bill, with every charge listed
checklist.why: Every charge must be shown separately

checklist.name: Payment receipts
checklist.source: Hospital billing desk – ask for a receipt for each payment

checklist.name: Cancelled cheque or bank details
checklist.why: So the insurer can pay you

checklist.name: Photo ID and address proof
checklist.source: PAN or Aadhaar of the person who holds the policy
checklist.why: The insurer must check who you are

checklist.name: Hospital note saying no cheaper room was free
checklist.why: If no room within ₹5,000 a day was free, the insurer may pay more

checklist.name: A list of what the ₹9,500 cut is for
checklist.source: The insurer – ask for it in your letter
checklist.why: The insurer's letter gives no reason for this amount

escalation.name: The insurer's complaints team
escalation.when: First step. Write to the insurer with your questions and papers.
escalation.howTo: Use the complaint email or form on the insurer's website. Note the reference number.

escalation.name: Bima Bharosa (the insurance regulator's complaint site)
escalation.when: If the insurer doesn't reply in time, or you disagree with the reply.
escalation.howTo: Register the complaint online on the Bima Bharosa website.

escalation.name: Insurance Ombudsman (free, independent judge)
escalation.when: If it is still not solved. There is a time limit after the insurer's final reply – check it first.
escalation.howTo: File with the Ombudsman office for your area.
